## A separate theorem

::: {#thm-positive-square}
## Positive square

For any nonzero real number $x$, the square $x^2$ is positive.
:::

::: {#prf-positive-square .proof for="thm-positive-square" data-kg-proves="math:positive-square"}
For a nonzero real number, either $x>0$ or $-x>0$. The product of two positive
real numbers is positive. In either case, $x^2>0$.
:::

@thm-positive-square and @def-group-action remain native Quarto cross-references.
The theorem does not depend on the group-action definition. The proof's explicit
association is an authored attribute, not a claim that a proof checker ran.

The reference [@synthetic2026] is fictional and exists only to check that the
filter preserves citation processing.
